text:
sam.nguyen: Quick sync — planning to flip the PII_LOGGING_V2 toggle into "audit" for a canary next Tue (09:30 PST). Need ops+security sign-off and a KMS/HSM path sanity check.
emi.chen: scope? which teams are in the canary and how long?
sam.nguyen: Canary audience = data-team + search-team for 2 hours. If no errors, extend to infra-team for 4 hours, then full. Guardrails: auto-rollback on >0.5% error rate or any PII-exfil alert.
raj.patel: HSM fallback question: if primary KMS fails, do we fall back to software KMS or block writes? need clear policy.
sam.nguyen: Current plan: priority order = customer-KMS -> HSM (via kms-proxy) -> software-KMS (readonly for reads only, writes blocked). Ops must confirm kms-proxy circuit-breaker timeout and alerting.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by deploy-bot for 2025-11-18T17:30:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled with threshold checks.
liz.zhu: tagging a quick CR review: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4821 — the flag plumbing and metrics emit are in that CL.
emi.chen: small note: retention_grace_seconds default is 604800 (7d). For audit mode we should set to 0 for canary, otherwise logs might persist longer than desired. Security sign-off needed.
sam.nguyen: Good catch. Proposed canary config snippet: 
```json
{
  "flag": "PII_LOGGING_V2",
  "state": "audit",
  "scope": {
    "canary": ["data-team", "search-team"]
  },
  "retention_grace_seconds": 0,
  "kms_priority": ["customer-kms", "hsm-proxy", "software-kms"]
}
```
raj.patel: Also add metric names to watch: pii.audit.count, pii.audit.errors, kms.fallback.count, kms.latency.p99.
emi.chen: Will request privacy sign-off on retention change. Also confirm HSM rotation window — we need key usage logs enabled.
liz.zhu: I can validate metrics dashboard and add a coupled alert for kms.fallback.count > 1 in 5m.
ops-bot: Reminder: run `redwoodctl flags preview PII_LOGGING_V2 --env=staging` before prod flip.
sam.nguyen: Rollback playbook (short):
1) `redwoodctl flags set PII_LOGGING_V2 off --scope=prod`
2) Re-enable previous flag PII_LOGGING_LEGACY if needed
3) Notify sec + SLACK #oncall
(we'll attach the full runbook to the PR)
emi.chen: Do we need a canary kill-switch for HSM failures specifically? I prefer a fast path to disable HSM fallback to avoid corrupted writes.
raj.patel: Agree. Add `hsm.fallback.enabled` flag that ops can toggle. Default true. Canary sets it false during first 2 hours.
sam.nguyen: Owners/actions: ops (verify kms-proxy CB & alerts), liz (dashboard + alert), emi (privacy sign-off), raj (HSM fallback flag + metrics), sam (deploy + runbook).
liz.zhu: I'll put the dashboard PR up today.
emi.chen: privacy ok to review tomorrow morning, ETA 10:30 PST.
raj.patel: I'll add hsm.fallback flag PR and tests.
sam.nguyen: All right — if everyone OK, I'll post the canary run details to #eng-deploy and kick off preview tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Canary ticket created: INF-3427. Linked to PR-4821.
emi.chen: :thumbsup:
liz.zhu: :+1:
__notes: This thread is a short coordination convo about a compliance-related feature flag canary and KMS/HSM fallback planning.
